groups.interpretation: Policy validation before seed length check; at least two main rows; class description not additional runtime guarantee.
Store direction/options, shallow list copies retain row objects; construct timedelta then validate seed with null predecessors.
Construct detector outside try; only after construction run retained _detect inside try, release indexes by exact sequence identities in finally. Constructor failure not covered by cleanup.
After successful detection and release assign result, normal checkpoint and initial cursor; processed count starts zero.
Result property returns snapshot of committed result.
Dataclass replace result, shallow replace each mutable candidate, new resets list retaining Reset objects; no recursive clone.
Construct UnifiedReactionDetector with full window zero to len(main)-1 and stored direction/options.
Delegate exact sequence identity release to release_market_indexes; no general global reset.
Positive timeframe and both nonempty required; ordered OR short circuit; violation raises LiveReactionUnavailable.

Main initial predecessor None requires index zero; otherwise compute gap first then consecutive stored index, positive gap, exact modulo grid alignment in order. Gaps of multiple timeframes allowed. On valid row advance local predecessor.
Lower starts index zero only without predecessor; else consecutive stored index and strictly increasing timestamp; no equal timestamps, no fixed cadence requirement. Advance local predecessor.
Validate lower first>=new main first and lower last<new main last+nominal timeframe, lower-bound comparison first. No per-main coverage guarantee.
Advance forwards both input sequences with commit True.
Preview forwards with commit False; docstring does not establish deep immutability.
If both empty return committed snapshot without validation/commit; one empty reaches validation error. Otherwise validate with last committed predecessors before concatenation.
New shallow concatenated main/lower lists, construct detector before protected replay; read committed checkpoint before try.
Checkpoint None: processed=len(new main input), retained _detect with saved initial cursor; metric counts supplied new span, not loop iterations.

Else slice reaction/reset prefixes at stored counts, retaining elements; shallow replace cursor and previous and optional candidate separately; processed full next main length minus saved next index (can include replay).
Replay _scan_normal with retain True, stop gate None; finally release indexes for combined lists. Exceptions before try (construction) not covered; cleanup failure can prevent later publication.

Only commit truthy writes lists, result, checkpoint, initial cursor then increments metric sequentially; preview skips these assignments. No universal transactional rollback or guarantee on shared aliases.
Return snapshot after optional commit, so snapshot failure can occur after committed state updates; terminal blanks no operation.

supplemental.historical: Validate policy then seed length; store direction/options and shallow list copies, create duration, validate entire seed with null predecessors. Construct detector before try; finally releases indexes only after successful construction enters try. Save result/checkpoint/initial cursor after cleanup; processed zero.

Result property snapshots via replace, shallow copies mutable candidates individually and reset list; reset objects retained. Detector full 0..len-1 and stored flags. Release indexes by original list identity.

Positive duration and both nonempty required; main first index zero only when no predecessor; else compute gap before consecutive-index, positive-gap, integral-timeframe modulo conjunction. No requirement of exactly one timeframe gap.

Lower initial index zero or consecutive index and strictly increasing time. Endpoints confined to new main start inclusive, last main nominal end exclusive. No local requirement of gap-free lower coverage, or per-main lower rows.

Advance commit true, preview false. Both empty returns snapshot without validation or mutation; one empty reaches validation error. Combine lists with original row references, construct detector before protected try.

Checkpoint null uses initial cursor and processed=len(new main); otherwise shallow-slice accepted prefixes, copy cursor/previous/candidate and replay normal from saved next. Processed full length minus next. Release new sequence indexes in finally. Constructor failure outside finally.

Commit assigns new lists, result, checkpoint, initial cursor, then increments count; snapshot performed afterward and can fail natively. Preview skips these assignments, but no universal deep immutability or rollback guarantee. Final terminal blanks no procedure.

decision_order: Policy before seed size; shallow list copies; positive timeframe/grid/chronology/range validation.
Detector construction before cleanup scope; retained detection or prefix replay inside try; finally identity release.
Snapshot separates candidate records and list containers, not all nested objects.
Empty both no-op; one empty invalid; prefix and cursor replay; metric counts spans.
Preview skips owned-field assignment; commit sequentially publishes before result snapshot. No transactional rollback guarantee.

findings.meaning: Clarify validation evaluation, shallow ownership, identity cleanup and pre/post-commit failure boundaries, processed count semantics. Preserve B02-14-F01/F02.

limitations: Local source semantics, not runtime equivalence or complete cross-owner acceptance. Consumer failure, cache and projection obligations remain open.
remaining: B03–B10 local review and all cross-owner obligations.
